## Context

DL-002's 500ms was too aggressive — caused thundering herd on a partial
outage.

## Decision

Bump fixed interval to 1000ms. Keep 3 retries.

## Consequences

Slower failure mode (3s vs 1.5s) but no retry storm in the last
incident. Superseded by DL-005 once we adopt exponential backoff.
